verdict.rationale: Orb's subscription-creation docs say billing cycles can also be aligned to the subscription's creation date. The word "also" implies a choice between anniversary billing and a default (likely calendar) alignment, which covers the core calendar-vs-anniversary element. That support rests on a single thin mention. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of calendar billing as a selectable anchor, alignment of billing cycles across a customer's multiple subscriptions, custom invoice or anchor dates, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
